name: alg_odd_card_order_two_of_even_card
statement: (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (h : Even (Nat.card G)) : Odd (Nat.card {g : G // orderOf g = 2})
closed: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (h : Even (Nat.card G)), Odd (Nat.card {g : G // orderOf g = 2})
informal: In a finite group of even order the number of elements of order exactly 2 is odd — pair g with g⁻¹: the elements with g ≠ g⁻¹ come in pairs, so |{g : g² = 1}| is even, and removing the identity leaves an odd number.
type: ∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group G] [Finite G], Even (Nat.card G) → Odd (Nat.card { g // orderOf g = 2 })
